findings.summary: Reuse CapturedClosure directly throughout function emission instead of splitting and reconstructing its state and interface.
Remove the singleton Set allocation when describing a materialized native binding.
Remove the retained-callback fixture template and dead conditional branch for the deleted std::function specialization.
Replace stale audio-context metadata commentary with the current native handle ownership contract.
Reuse shader IR typeComponents for scalar/vector constructor widths while explicitly refusing matrices.
Reuse buildGlb in codec-selection tests instead of duplicating GLB framing and padding.
Replace per-entry GC map allocations with sorted owner identity storage and one shared binary lookup helper.
Reuse context-owned audio traversal storage and mark reachability on existing graph nodes instead of allocating a set each frame.
Preserve concrete capture helper signatures and renderer guards when visual capture is disabled.
